messages:
Ava T: Quick update — Altair Edge agreed to run a 10-day early access for their new GA100-MX nodes in July. NDA signed. Link: (internal)
Miguel P: Nice. What do they provide? jumpbox, creds, storage?
Ava T: Jumpbox + per-team S3, container image with drivers. Window Jul 10-20. They want a short bench report and a brief tech note for internal marketing.
OpsBot: Reminder: create /partnerships/altair-preview workspace
Jin W: For bench matrix propose: gpt-3.5-small fp16, llama-13b fp16, multi-gpu 2/4-way scaling. Metrics: p95 latency, throughput, mem headroom, NCCL error logs.
Carmen S: Please request exact firmware, driver, and NIC firmware from Altair. Also ask about PCIe vs NVLink and whether MIG is supported.
Miguel P: I'll draft access request: "please confirm GPU SKU, cuda/driver, NIC, firmware, jumpbox IP, and S3 ACLs"
Ava T: Add compliance checks: allowed screenshot policy under NDA and retention for logs. Legal needs to pre-approve any data we upload.
Jin W: Fallback: if GA100-MX lacks necessary int8 ops, we'll run int8 on Redwood Dedicated and mark as "fallback".
Carmen S: I'll prepare a 150-prompt eval set (PII-free) and route to legal.
Miguel P: Timeline: bench plan by Jun 30, access creds by Jul 8, run Jul 10-20, internal review Jul 23. I'll create a PR pre-brief placeholder.
Ava T: Great — drop bench plan link here once ready and I'll send to Altair with onboarding checklist.
